raw_run_table.provenance_note: The original run_table_2021-07.csv is no longer present on disk. The _fixed file was produced by the dataset owner (user-confirmed 2026-09-13); its first three columns (datetime, service, message) preserve the original raw fields and `message` contains the full raw log line (ts,ms | LEVEL | node_ip | container_ip | service | payload). Columns timestamp/level/service_node/anomaly_type/duration_seconds are the owner's pre-parse CLAIMS: this audit re-derives all semantics from the raw message text and cross-checks against these columns instead of trusting them.
